releases.title: Update notes preview
changes: When Selah finds a newer version, it now opens the patch notes immediately so the update does not feel silent.
The local updater still installs from GitHub through the app, and saved highlights, notes, the bookmark, and reading history stay backed up.
This keeps the automatic update flow visible while you verify the new version.

releases.title: Updater verification checkpoint
changes: Bumped Selah to a new release so the local updater can be tested against a fresh version.
Saved highlights, notes, the bookmark, and reading history should carry through the update unchanged.
This release exists to confirm the automatic update flow end to end.

releases.title: Automatic local updater
changes: Update now installs the latest GitHub version through Selah's local server instead of opening a zip download.
Saved highlights, notes, reading place, and reading history are backed up before the update runs.
If local files have been changed, Selah stops before overwriting anything and shows a message.

releases.title: Reading history on the live release
changes: The live release now includes Reading History in the book selection screen.
It remembers the last 50 chapters you've read.
You can jump back to any of those chapters from the list.

releases.title: Reading history in the book picker
changes: Added Reading History in the book selection screen.
It remembers the last 50 chapters you've read.
You can jump back to any of those chapters from the list.

releases.title: Updater panel cleanup
changes: Removed the extra divider lines in the updater panel version section.
Kept the manual update flow in place so you can verify the update button safely.
This gave the local test build a newer GitHub version to detect.

releases.title: Updater button restored
changes: Restored the manual Update now button after checking for a newer build.
The check-for-update flow still waits for your confirmation instead of refreshing automatically.
This gives you a clean GitHub target to test against.

releases.title: Update check verification
changes: Bumped the live manifest so the update checker has a newer build to detect.
This lets you verify that the check-for-update button still works against GitHub.
The tab and theme cleanup from the previous checkpoint remains in place.

releases.title: Theme and toggle polish
changes: Regular dark mode now uses a cleaner neutral palette instead of borrowing the green-dark look.
The pronunciation toggle has a clearer switch treatment across themes.
The version indicator now shows 2.0.9 so you can visually confirm the latest checkpoint.

releases.title: Version history and speed ticks
changes: In the corner of the version section, added a version history page that has all the update board information.
Added ticks to the speed bar that snap to them so the reading speed stays a nice round consistent number.

releases.title: Settings and update cleanup
changes: Removed the ON text to the right of the pronunciation toggle switch.
Added a Set to default button for the reading speed.
Removed the up-to-date box with the version number from the version section.
If Selah is up to date after checking for updates, it now shows the message next to the button.

releases.title: Automatic update notes
changes: Checking for updates now refreshes Selah automatically when a newer build is available.
After the refresh, Selah opens a patch notes window with the version number and what changed.
The update manifest can now list multiple releases so users who skip versions can review every missed update.

releases.title: Read aloud and pronunciation polish
changes: Changed original-language definition pronunciation to a toggle switch.
Saved highlights, saved notes, and search read-aloud buttons now switch between play and pause while in use.
